text:
DeployBot: :warning: CI Alert — pipeline on master turned red after merge 7a9b3f. Failing job: e2e-gateway (step 7/12) — timed out at 00:10:32. CI: https://ci.redwood/67789

mira: @channel who owns the gateway e2e? This landed ~5m ago — need a quick triage so we can decide rerun vs revert

jon: jon: I can take a look, kicking off a rerun now

infra-oncall: infra-oncall: FYI we saw a short-lived node pressure event in us-west-2 ~14:05 UTC, could be related to pod scheduling delays

jon: jon: rerun started: https://ci.redwood/67789/rerun. If it flakes again I'll start a bisect of the merge range

mira: mira: pasting the failing snippet from the original run:
```
[2026-03-18T14:07:12Z] gateway-integration ERROR dial tcp 127.0.0.1:8080: connect: connection refused
[2026-03-18T14:07:13Z] test harness: attempt 1/3 failed - grpc dial timeout
```

sam: sam: that looks like the gateway container never accepted connections — could be startup probe timing or a transient port bind race. Can someone check k8s events for the failed pod?

jon: jon: checking events now — saw CrashLoopBackOff on gateway-integration-5. Image pulled fine; liveness probe returned 502 repeatedly. Event excerpt: `Warning Unhealthy kubelet liveness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 502`

infra-oncall: infra-oncall: confirms node pressure + a couple of kubelet eviction warnings around the same window. Might be infra noise rather than app regression

mira: mira: ok — if it's infra noise we should prefer rerun. Product tests are blocked though; need a decision: revert the merge or rerun and mark non-blocking?

sam: sam: proposal — attempt up to 2 reruns. If both fail, start a bisect or temporary revert. That keeps churn low but protects prod tests

jon: jon: kicked second rerun, watching the job. Ping me directly if it gets stuck >10m

DeployBot: DeployBot: Rerun finished — job succeeded on rerun #2. Marking as rerun-success in CI dashboard

mira: mira: thanks — filing follow-up to harden startup probe and track infra blips. Created GH issue #4567 to increase probe timeout and add better logging. Assigning to @sam

sam: sam: ack, I'll pick up the probe timeout PR tomorrow and add a note in the runbook. Closing this triage for now unless it recurs :thumbsup:
